newsitem.title: SPAIN: Soldier shoots corporal who refused to shoot him.
newsitem.headline: Soldier shoots corporal who refused to shoot him.

text.p: A sergeant major in the Spanish army turned his gun on a young corporal and shot him dead after the soldier refused an order to shoot him, the Defence Ministry said on Sunday.

According to media reports, Sergeant Major Juan Carlos Miravete on Saturday pointed his gun at the heads of some of a group of 20 reservists he had been training in the Pyrenees mountains, shouting: "Are you afraid to die?".
He was said to have handed his gun to 19-year-old Samuel Ferrer and ordered the soldier to shoot him, and when he refused, Miravete was reported to have grabbed the gun and shot Ferrer in the chest.
Witnesses said the sergeant major had been drinking heavily before the attack, according to local media.
Defence Minister Eduardo Serra told reporters he had ordered an urgent investigation into the incident.
Miravete appeared before a judge on Sunday, the ministry said.
